arabic text: kya dhoond rahi hai jangal may sakina\nabbas ke baazu ya baba ka seena
english translation text: What is Sakina searching for in the wilderness—\nAbbas's arms, or Baba's chest?

arabic text: kano se chine gowhar aur aag thi daman may\nghabrayi hui bachi ye kehti rahi ran may\nhai koi jo mujhko pohnchade madina
english translation text: Her earrings were torn from her ears and her dress was aflame;\nthe frightened child kept crying throughout the battlefield:\nis there anyone who can take me back to Madina?

arabic text: ran se ali asghar ko le aao mere baba\nsoona nazar aata hai bhai ka mere jhoola\nasghar ke baghair ab mujhko nahi jeena
english translation text: Baba, bring Ali Asghar back from the battlefield;\nmy brother's cradle looks empty.\nWithout Asghar, I no longer wish to live

arabic text: ye shaam ke zindan may deewaron ko takti hai\nkya soch ke ye jaane din raat sisakti hai\nbichdi hai chacha se jab se ye hazeena
english translation text: In the prison of Shaam, she stares at the walls;\nwho knows what she thinks as she sobs day and night?\nShe has remained sorrowful since separation from her uncle

arabic text: dunya se sidhare hai bhai jo mere pyase\njab tak nahi lautenge ammu mere darya se\nmaine ay phupi jaan pani nahi peena
english translation text: My thirsty brother has departed this world;\nuntil my uncle returns from the river,\nI will not drink water, O my aunt

arabic text: pohnche jo shahe wala bete ki sada sunkar\ndekha ke ragadte hai aydi ko jawan akbar\nnaize ki ani hai aur bete ka seena
english translation text: When the exalted King reached him after hearing his son's call,\nhe saw young Akbar rubbing his heels against the earth;\nthe spear-point was lodged within his chest

arabic text:
ahmed ke nawase ko maara hai moharram may
chalees baras roye sajjad isi gham may
tareekh pukari hai gham ka mahina
.
english translation text:
Ahmed's grandson was killed in Muharram;
Sajjad wept over this grief for
forty years. History itself proclaims: this
is the month of sorrow
